=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/unblock_scan.py:266-279 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: `_last_run_times` counts a judge run that ended `failure` or `timed_out` as having judged the item, so the 24-hour `fixup_escalated` window opens after a run that may have crashed early.
  WHY: The re-grant check for an escalated, scope-blocked fix-up waits up to 24 hours instead of about one hour; the skip is bounded and there is no loop, so the reviewer rated it a NIT.
- scripts/unblock_scan.py:234-263 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: `_terminal_unchanged` reads only `labeled` events, so it cannot tell who removed `ai:needs-human` or whether the park label was removed at all.
  WHY: An item a person deliberately un-parked, with no new comment and no new block label, is skipped as `terminal_unchanged` instead of being re-judged; this is the intended #639 trade-off and the reviewer rated it a NIT.
- scripts/unblock_scan.py:242-263 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The terminal skip in `_terminal_unchanged` (called at lines 381-384) treats the returned comments as complete evidence even when the poller marks the comment history incomplete, because it runs before the `history_incomplete` check at lines 390-392.
  WHY: An older comment outside the 30-comment window can be edited after the close verdict and `_has_new_evidence` cannot see it, so the re-judge is suppressed; the reviewer rated it a NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
